arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-02-01' AND date < '2019-03-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in February 2019, whether or not they carry a fraud label.
assumptions: February 2019 means dates from 2019-02-01 up to but not including 2019-03-01.
All transactions are counted, including those without a fraud label.
